nodes.text: Yes, for the death of Themistocles is preferable.
Demosthenes
No, by Zeus, but neat wine, to the Good Spirit.
Perhaps then we might hit on some good plan.
Nicias
Listen to him: “neat”! So your mind is on drinking?
How could a man plan anything good while drunk?
Demosthenes
Really, you? You're a gushing water-pot of drivel.
You dare to slander wine as a spur to invention?
Could you find anything more effective than wine?
You see, it's when men drink that
they get rich, get things done, win lawsuits,
are happy, help their friends.
Come on, bring me out a jug of wine, quick,
so I can water my wits and say something clever.
Nicias
Oh dear, what on earth will you do to us with your drinking?
Demosthenes
Good things. Just bring it; I'll lie down.
For if I get drunk, I'll sprinkle this whole place
with little plans and little maxims and little notions.
Nicias
How lucky that I wasn't caught inside
stealing the wine.
Demosthenes
Tell me, what is the Paphlagonian doing?
Nicias
Having licked up some confiscated titbits, the slanderer
is snoring drunk, flat on his back among the hides.
Demosthenes
Go on then, gurgle me in plenty of neat wine
as a libation.
Nicias
Here, take it and pour a libation to the Good Spirit.
Demosthenes
Drink, drink down the cup of the Pramnian Spirit.
